# Planning level

**How much is decided before the camera rolls?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C30


## Storyboard every beat
<a id="storyboard"></a>

A table with every line, what's on screen, which tool, and the sound cue, agreed before shooting or editing.

**Looks like:** A 24-row table: '01 · 0:00–0:02.8 · I didn't edit a single second · hook text from frame 0 · SCORE: drop on Claude did.' The edit matches the plan.

**Good at:** precise edits; AI edits that match intent; fewer re-edits; planned sound moments

**Weak at:** slow; can kill spontaneity

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals retention, trust · effort high

**How:** Prompt Claude for the table (# / time / say / on screen / tool / sound cue) and approve it before 'build it'.

**Backed by:** [Storyboard table before any edit](../topics/process.md#l10-storyboard-before-edit), [SCORE and EMPHASIS lines per beat](../topics/sound.md#l10-storyboard-score-emphasis), [Edit blueprint per video](../topics/process.md#proc-edit-blueprint), [Visual table of contents in the first 2 s](../topics/hooks.md#l11-toc-intro), [Something new on screen every 1.2–2.5 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-change-every-1-5-2-5s) · sources L10, SP

## Light script from a framework
<a id="script-framework"></a>

Bullet points from a frame (hook, story, two points; or 8 Mile), and several versions of the hook.

**Looks like:** A notes-app card with a hook line and three bullets. Five hook versions are written side by side and the best is picked.

**Good at:** structure without stiffness; better hooks via versions; fast to write

**Weak at:** edit decisions made later; less precise sound and visual timing

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, speed · effort medium

**How:** Use the frameworks from L06. Write 4–5 hook versions and get feedback.

**Backed by:** [Script: hook → story → 2 points](../topics/story.md#story-hook-story-two-points), ["8 Mile": disprove the counter-argument first](../topics/story.md#story-8-mile), [Write 4–5 versions side by side](../topics/process.md#proc-four-five-versions), [Teaching format: template card, then a real example](../topics/editing.md#l11-template-then-example), [Hook = title + verbal + visual](../topics/hooks.md#hook-title-verbal-visual) · sources L06, L09

## Improvise with pauses (ReCut)
<a id="improvise-recut"></a>

Talk freely; pause in silence to think; cut the silences later and re-record the intro at the end.

**Looks like:** A 6–7 minute raw take cut down to 60 s of the best lines. The intro was recorded last, when warmed up.

**Good at:** natural delivery; speed; no script anxiety

**Weak at:** more cutting; can wander

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-long · niches all · goals speed, trust · effort low

**How:** Silence removal in CapCut (or the ReCut app), then jump cuts and captions.

**Backed by:** [Pause in silence to think](../topics/filming.md#film-recut-pause-method), [Re-record the intro at the end](../topics/filming.md#film-redo-intro-at-end), [Yap Map: 3–5 ideas a day](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-yap-map), [Axial jump cuts every 3–6 words](../topics/editing.md#edit-axial-jump-cuts), [Pause-and-play breakdown of a reel](../topics/ideas.md#l10-pause-and-play-breakdown) · sources L06

## Press play and just post
<a id="press-play"></a>

Minimal planning: turn the camera on, say the thing, post it.

**Looks like:** A camera-on, step-back clip shot in one go. Sometimes these are the best performers.

**Good at:** volume; authenticity; beats perfectionism

**Weak at:** inconsistent; weak hooks slip through

**Best for:** formats reel30, story, yt-short · niches all · goals speed · effort low

**How:** One take and auto-captions in Edits.

**Backed by:** [Don't overthink: say something crazy](../topics/hooks.md#hook-say-something-crazy), [Perfect is the enemy of posted](../topics/growth.md#growth-perfect-enemy-of-posted), [Pick one goal: comments, sends or saves](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-conversation-goal), ["Take a picture" save moment](../topics/growth.md#growth-screenshot-save-moment), [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall) · sources L08, L05

## Mixing
A storyboard can be written after an improvised take (plan the edit, not the talk). Script frameworks fit inside improvising.

## Rule of thumb
Effect-heavy or AI-built edits: storyboard. Talking reels: light script or ReCut. Volume weeks: press play.
